from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "${meas}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${select_export_data_list})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["storehouse_id"] == "${rack_id}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${qrcode})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value", "qrcode", "storehouse_id", "serialboard_id", "protectboard_id"])
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _field:
        if r._field == "voltage" then r.qrcode + "_Volt"
        else if r._field == "temperature" then r.qrcode + "_Temp"
        else if r._field == "current" then "Current"
        else r._field
  }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      StoreHouseID: r.storehouse_id,
      SerialBoardID: r.serialboard_id,
      ProtectBoardID: r.protectboard_id
  }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "StoreHouseID", "SerialBoardID", "ProtectBoardID"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])

list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "${bucket}",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "${meas}" and r.storehouse_id == "${rack_id}" and r.serialboard_id == "${serialboard_id}",
  tag: "qrcode"
)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._value != "curr")
|> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r._value}))

list.definition:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '${qrcode_list:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
  SELECT r.expr, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS value
  FROM raw r
  CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(LTRIM(RTRIM(expr))) IN ('All') THEN 'true'
    ELSE STRING_AGG('r["qrcode"] == "' + value + '"', ' or ')
  END AS result
FROM split_expr;
